evals.name: create-grounded-release
evals.prompt: Read plans/recreation/ExecPlan.md, then create its sibling accomplishment report. GrowHub Nursery Operations (GNO) released version 1.27.0 on October 5, 2026. The nursery seedling production and fulfillment workflow shipped and 18 acceptance tests passed; deployment and adoption are outside scope. This supports Forest Service reforestation and operational efficiency because nursery staff can manage seedlings for restoration. Baseline equivalent human work is estimated at 24 hours based on analogous completed nursery workflow work; AI-assisted human effort is 6 hours, including prompting, review, testing, and correction. My supplied fully burdened rate is USD 100/hour. All acceptance checks and milestones are complete.
evals.expected_output: Write one sibling paragraph following the approved template with the date, known version, complete app name and acronym, supported priority rationale, 18 saved development hours and USD 1,800 estimated labor savings. Follow it with brief notes showing (24 - 6) × USD 100/hour = USD 1,800 and the estimate basis. Do not claim deployment or adoption.
assertions: One copy-ready paragraph followed by calculation notes
Begins with Released on October 5, then version 1.27.0, then GrowHub Nursery Operations (GNO); omits the release year
Claims exactly 18 development hours and USD 1800 using supplied wage
Calculation notes include baseline, assisted effort, rate, arithmetic and assumptions
Alignment is supported and deployment/adoption are not claimed

evals.name: revise-negative-savings
evals.prompt: Read plans/internal/ExecPlan.md, then update its existing accomplishment-report.md in place. Preserve the human-written owner note. The application is Incident Procurement Automation (IIPA); no release date or version applies. It delivered incident contract modification capabilities, and no agency-priority connection is supported by the evidence. Baseline equivalent human effort is defensibly estimated at 10 hours from the documented manual workflow. AI-assisted human work took 12 hours including prompting, oversight, review, testing, corrections, and integration. My supplied wage is USD 80/hour. Acceptance is complete. Be honest about the result.
evals.expected_output: Update the same file, preserve the note, and report negative savings honestly: -2 development hours and -USD 160 estimated labor savings. Include brief arithmetic and assumptions. Do not invent a release date, version, or agency alignment.
assertions: Existing file updated without duplicate; preserves the exact line Owner note: adoption review scheduled for November.
Uses full application name and acronym; omits inapplicable date/version
Reports -2 development hours and -USD 160 labor savings, not positive savings
Calculation notes show 10 baseline hours, 12 assisted hours and USD 80/hour
Does not invent agency alignment

evals.name: missing-wage
evals.prompt: Read plans/tooling/ExecPlan.md and prepare its accomplishment report. The application is WorkPlan Reports (WPR). Its export workflow is complete and acceptance passed. A defensible estimate is 16 human-only development hours versus 5 AI-assisted human hours, including prompting, review, testing, and integration. No wage rate or currency has been supplied.
evals.expected_output: Ask the user for their hourly wage and currency and keep the report pending. Do not finalize a labor-cost amount or substitute an illustrative rate before the answer. After the follow-up supplies USD 100/hour, save plans/tooling/accomplishment-report.md without requiring another report request, reporting 11 development hours saved and USD 1,100 estimated labor savings with calculation notes.
assertions: Asks for user-supplied hourly wage and currency
Does not use illustrative fallback wage
Does not finalize a cost claim without the missing input
Keeps the report pending rather than skipping it or marking reporting complete because the wage is missing
After the wage-only follow-up, saves plans/tooling/accomplishment-report.md without another report request
Saved report includes 11 development hours saved and USD 1100 labor savings, with calculation notes showing (16 - 5) × USD 100/hour

evals.name: incomplete-stale
evals.prompt: Read plans/incomplete/ExecPlan.md, then close out the plan and create its accomplishment report. Its progress checkboxes are all checked, but milestone acceptance says not met: the end-to-end export test is failing and owner signoff is pending. Do not fix implementation or edit the plan during this reporting task.
evals.expected_output: Do not create an accomplishment report or mark the plan done. Explain the unresolved test and pending signoff despite checked boxes.
assertions: No report created
Identifies acceptance failure and pending signoff
Does not change plan or implementation

evals.name: zero-savings
evals.prompt: Read plans/tooling/ExecPlan.md and create its sibling accomplishment report. WorkPlan Reports (WPR) completed the export workflow; all acceptance checks passed. No release date or version applies. Comparable human-only effort is estimated at 8 hours from a documented prior workflow, and measured AI-assisted human work was 8 hours including prompting, review, testing, correction, and integration. My wage is USD 90/hour. No agency-priority connection is supported by the supplied evidence.
evals.expected_output: Write one copy-ready paragraph with no release or version prefix. Close with 0 estimated development hours saved and USD 0 labor-cost savings. Include (8 - 8) × USD 90/hour = USD 0 in supporting notes; do not invent other benefits or agency alignment.
assertions: Reports 0 development hours and USD 0 labor-cost savings
Uses full application name and acronym without release date or version prefix
Shows 8 baseline hours, 8 assisted hours and USD 90/hour in calculation notes
Does not claim positive savings or unsupported agency alignment

evals.name: insufficient-effort
evals.prompt: Read plans/tooling/ExecPlan.md and prepare its accomplishment report. WorkPlan Reports (WPR) completed the export workflow; acceptance passed. My wage is USD 90/hour. The only effort-related data available are 3 hours of autonomous agent runtime and 27 commits between 09:00 and 17:00. No human time was logged, no comparable prior work exists, and there is no scope breakdown supporting a human-effort estimate. No release date or version applies.
evals.expected_output: Ask for defensible human-only and AI-assisted human effort estimates and their evidence basis. Do not use agent runtime, commits or timestamps as human labor. Do not finalize a report with invented hours or labor-cost savings.
assertions: Asks for both human-only and AI-assisted human effort with supporting evidence
Does not infer human labor from runtime, commits or timestamps
Does not finalize an unsupported cost claim or change the plan

evals.name: explicit-hourly-wage
evals.prompt: Invoke accomplishment-report with --hourly-wage 125 USD for plans/recreation/ExecPlan.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the invocation rate of USD 125/hour despite the older USD 100/hour recorded in the plan. Report 18 development hours saved and USD 2,250 labor-cost savings without asking for a wage already supplied.
assertions: Uses explicit argument rate USD 125/hour rather than the older plan rate
Reports 18 development hours and USD 2250 labor-cost savings
Does not ask for the supplied wage or currency

evals.name: invalid-hourly-wage
evals.prompt: Invoke accomplishment-report with --hourly-wage unknown USD for plans/recreation/ExecPlan.md.
evals.expected_output: Ask for a valid numeric hourly wage. Do not silently substitute the older USD 100/hour rate from the plan or finalize a cost claim.
assertions: Asks to correct the nonnumeric wage argument
Does not fall back to the older plan rate
Does not finalize a cost report or alter the plan
